name: _set_seq_context
note: review: setExprContext's Tuple/List arms map the element list (len 0 -> NULL is the same empty elts once _PyAST_Tuple stores it), action_helpers.c:246-266; but the only entry, pygrammar-check-targets (TargetValidates, Check/Targets.lean:164), pins only that every target position of the result carries ctx (Heads): a rewrite that drops elements still satisfies it; SetContextLast/SetContextRestores, which pin that nothing else moves, have empty pyFns (RowNames check_set_context_last/_restores) and credit no row.

name: _set_name_context
note: review: setExprContext's Name arm keeps id and location (action_helpers.c:269-272), but TargetValidates (the only entry, pygrammar-check-targets) pins only the ctx of target positions: a Name with another id or location satisfies it; the entries that pin preservation (pygrammar-check-set-context-last/-restores) have empty pyFns.

name: _set_tuple_context
note: review: setExprContext's Tuple arm mirrors action_helpers.c:275-282, but TargetValidates pins only the ctx of target positions (Heads.tuple holds for an empty elts): a Tuple that loses or reorders its elements, or its EXTRA_EXPR(e, e) location, satisfies it; SetContextRestores, which would catch that, has empty pyFns.

name: _set_list_context
note: review: setExprContext's List arm mirrors action_helpers.c:285-292, but TargetValidates pins only the ctx of target positions: a List that drops its elements or location satisfies it; the preservation entries have empty pyFns.

name: _set_subscript_context
note: review: setExprContext's Subscript arm keeps value and slice (action_helpers.c:295-299), but TargetValidates (Heads.sub accepts any value and slice) pins only ctx: a Subscript with another slice or value satisfies it; the preservation entries have empty pyFns.

name: _set_attribute_context
note: review: setExprContext's Attribute arm keeps value and attr (action_helpers.c:302-306), but TargetValidates (Heads.attr accepts any value and attr) pins only ctx: another attr satisfies it; the preservation entries have empty pyFns.

name: _set_starred_context
note: review: setExprContext's Starred arm recurses on value (action_helpers.c:309-316), and Heads.star does require the inner value's ctx, but nothing else of the inner value or the location is pinned by TargetValidates, the only entry; the preservation entries have empty pyFns.

name: _PyPegen_set_expr_context
note: review: setExprContext (Peg/Actions.lean:66-76) mirrors the switch of action_helpers.c:320-348 (default returns expr), with fuel 100000 from callHelper; but its only entry, pygrammar-check-targets, pins only that target positions carry ctx: element loss, a changed id/slice/attr or location all satisfy it; SetContextLast/SetContextRestores (Check/Targets.lean:180, 248), which pin the comment's 'equivalent to expr but with ctx as context', have empty pyFns, so listing these rows there is what is missing.
